name: Odin den' s Lenoj
source:
The story only spans a single day in the camp, yet during said day, anything can happen.

As usual, Semyon wakes up, already spending his fourth day in the camp - but this day will be different from all the others. At Olga Dmitrievna’s request, Semyon must spend the whole day with Lena, but how the day ends depends entirely on you.
